label: Listening 1 — Spell your name (5 people)
lines: Listening one. Spell your name. Listen and write the names.
Thanks, Emma. And what's your name?
Can you spell it for me?
Oh, hello! Are you the new teacher?
Yes, I am. I'm Mr Green.
Green. How do you spell that?
S. O. P. H. I. E.

label: Listening 2 — Numbers (5 people)
lines: Listening two. Listen and circle the right number.
Hi, I'm Tom, and I'm thirteen years old.
This is my grandmother. She's seventy-two, but she still plays tennis!
Hello, I'm Sara. My class is small. There are fifteen students in it.
My name's Ben. I take the bus to school. It's bus number forty-eight.
Our school is really big. We've got ninety computers!

label: Listening 3 — A phone call to an English school
lines: Listening three. A phone call. Listen and complete.
Hello. I'd like English lessons for my son, please.
And how do you spell Brooks?
B. R. double O. K. S.
Thank you. How old is Daniel?
Twelve, OK. And what's your phone number?
It's oh double seven, four double five, two oh one.
Oh double seven, four double five, two oh one. Lovely. His lesson is in room fourteen.
Room fourteen. Thank you very much. Goodbye.
Goodbye, and thank you for calling!
